criteria.evidence: src/domain/market-state.ts decodeMarketFrame routes JSON and bounded MessagePack inputs through the same parseMarketBatch schema boundary. tests/market-state.test.ts exercises equivalent JSON/MessagePack normalization and explicit malformed, codec, depth, size, count, control and mixed-frame rejection.

tests/market-state.test.ts loads fixtures/market/msgpack/{batch,connected,subscription,error}.bin directly and asserts normalized output. Static batch/control fixture cases execute; malformed, oversized, nested and mixed cases are separately falsifiable assertions. Structured focused-msgpack-tests.json records exit 0; focused log reports 37 tests passing.

src/infra/config.ts parses ALPACA_MARKET_DATA_CODEC into alpacaMarketDataCodec, but src/main.ts constructs AlpacaMarketStream without a codec option. AlpacaMarketStream defaults omitted codec to JSON (src/infra/alpaca-market-stream.ts:194) and selects the Content-Type plus binary/text expectations from that option (lines 140-141, 158-160). Thus setting ALPACA_MARKET_DATA_CODEC=msgpack is accepted and reported by config tests, but the application startup adapter still selects JSON. Existing adapter test supplies codec:'msgpack' directly, so it does not cover configuration-to-runtime wiring.

findings.summary: Configured MessagePack codec is not wired into the production stream adapter.
findings.impact: An operator selecting MessagePack through ALPACA_MARKET_DATA_CODEC receives a successful configuration load, but the actual Alpaca connection requests JSON and rejects binary frames. The application cannot fulfill the configured codec behavior in MPF-03.
findings.remediation: Pass config.alpacaMarketDataCodec to AlpacaMarketStream in src/main.ts and add a wiring-level test proving the configured value controls the real startup adapter's request content type and frame decoding mode.

limitations: Static MessagePack fixtures execute against the declared @msgpack/msgpack decoder and equivalent JSON normalization; they do not establish compatibility with a live Alpaca session or a specific upstream codec negotiation. No live credentialed connection was performed.
